atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: define design tokens. Each variable generates a CSS custom property and matching utilities and variants, for example --color-brand-500 gives bg-brand-500 and text-brand-500. Forms: @theme (default), @theme inline (inline the value instead of var()), @theme static (emit even when unused). @keyframes may be nested here.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: register a custom utility that works with every variant (hover:, sm:, dark:, and so on). Replaces the v3 @layer utilities pattern.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: apply a variant's styles inside plain CSS, the CSS-first equivalent of a variant prefix.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: define your own variant for class names, for example @custom-variant pointer-coarse (@media (pointer: coarse)); then use it as pointer-coarse:...

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind: inline existing utilities into a CSS rule. Prefer a component or theme variable for repeated patterns. In v4 it does not work across separately bundled stylesheets without @reference.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: add a file or directory to scan for class names, or safelist utilities with @source inline(...). Paths are relative to the stylesheet that declares it.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: import theme variables, custom utilities and variants from another stylesheet without duplicating any CSS. Needed for @apply in CSS modules and Vue/Svelte style blocks.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: load a JavaScript plugin from CSS, for example @plugin "@tailwindcss/typography";

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: load a legacy JavaScript config explicitly, it is no longer auto-detected. corePlugins, safelist and separator are not supported.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3 only: inject base, components or utilities. Removed in v4, use @import "tailwindcss"; instead.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3 only: nest breakpoint styles. Removed in v4, use the sm: and md: variants.

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3 only: generate responsive utilities. Removed in v4.
